bullets.text: In Chennai, PMK leader Anbumani Ramadoss claimed that constructing a boundary wall in the Pallikaranai marshland will cause a disaster.
The State Wetlands Authority told the Madras High Court that the interim zone of influence around the Pallikaranai marshland can be restricted to 36 survey numbers.
Residents of Pallikaranai appealed to leader Anbumani Ramadoss to secure proper water drainage pathways for their locality.
In Chennai, the state highways department is desilting and clearing three culverts along Jawaharlal Nehru Salai near the Velachery MRTS station to prevent floods.
In Chennai, the Madras High Court heard a case regarding the National Green Tribunal's construction ban within a one-kilometer radius of the Pallikaranai marshland.
In Pallikaranai, a maid and her lover were arrested for stealing gold, cash, and suitcases from doctor Karthik's apartment in Sholinganallur.
Residents in Poonamallee municipality suffered due to continuous power outages occurring during the night.
In Tiruttani, Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme workers protested and picketed the BDO office over low wages.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi launched development projects worth over thirteen thousand crore rupees across Tamil Nadu.
Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay urged Prime Minister Narendra Modi to grant early approval for Chennai Metro Rail phase-three.
Henox IT and Data Centers launched the Crest coastal submarine cable system to support digital and artificial intelligence connectivity in India.
HCLTech partnered with Anthropic to expand enterprise artificial intelligence deployment with safety, cybersecurity, and governance controls.
PMK leader Anbumani Ramadoss criticized Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam for continuing actions previously done by the DMK regarding the Pallikaranai marshland.
Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Vijay met Prime Minister Narendra Modi in Chennai to inaugurate a metro rail stretch and address a public event.
TVK MLA ECR P. Saravanan approached the Madras High Court to quash an FIR filed against him in an unauthorized banners case.
In Chennai, Prime Minister Narendra Modi pledged continued central support and unveiled development projects worth over thirteen thousand crore rupees for Tamil Nadu.
